# Code of conduct

Be respectful. Critique the work, not the person. Harassment, discrimination,
personal attacks, and sharing someone else's private information are not welcome.

This applies to project issues, pull requests, and discussions. Maintainers may
remove content or block repeated or serious violations. Use GitHub's
[reporting tools](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam)
to report abusive content privately.
